description: Country agricultural land, cereal yield, rural population, food production, fertilizer, water and agriculture value-added indicators
evidenceMethod: Official documentation review; no production SLA or quota test
coverage: 全球国家和地区的长期发展指标时间序列
limitations: 并非田块或实时数据；必须选择正确指标代码并理解统计口径
risks: CORS 未知，需要浏览器实测
recommendation: 建议通过服务端适配器统一鉴权、缓存、限流和错误处理。

scenarios.name: 粮食安全与农业发展指标

name: USDA ESMIS REST API
description: Search agricultural economics publications, agencies and report releases from the USDA Economics, Statistics and Market Information System
evidenceMethod: Official documentation review; no production SLA or quota test
coverage: USDA 农业经济、市场和统计出版物及发布记录
limitations: 主要返回出版物与发布元数据，不等同于报告中的完整结构化统计值
risks: CORS 未知，需要浏览器实测
recommendation: 建议通过服务端适配器统一鉴权、缓存、限流和错误处理。
